packageRules.description: Bump the Kubernetes libraries together — api/apimachinery/client-go must move in lockstep, and splitting them (as PRs #62/#63/#65 were) invites incompatible partial upgrades.
quic-go and webtransport-go are direct deps of BOTH Go modules; grouping makes a bump edit (and gomodTidy) both go.mod files in one PR so they never drift apart.
The Prometheus client libraries (client_golang + client_model) share a release cadence and transitive graph — land them together.
